description: Use when evaluating a pharmaceutical company, medical device manufacturer, or healthcare vendor for product safety risk, supply chain exposure, or regulatory compliance standing. Returns FDA recall classifications (Class I = risk of serious harm, Class II = moderate risk, Class III = unlikely to cause harm) with product descriptions and recall reasons. Class I recalls trigger mandatory FDA press releases and procurement review obligations. Example: MedSupply Corp — 2 Class I drug recalls in 36 months: contaminated IV solutions (2022) and mislabeled injectable (2023) — pattern of serious quality control failures requiring immediate vendor review. Source: OpenFDA Enforcement Reports. $0.10 USDC per call.
name: get_fda_recall_history
title: Get Fda Recall History
